parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment suggests that the authors should provide a precise definition or informal description of the notion of the spectrum of distributions and their characteristic functions. This is an explicit action (provide a definition or description) and it is clear what needs to be done. However, the comment does not give concrete details on how to implement this action, such as where exactly the definition should be placed, what formalism to use, or what an informal description should cover. Since the comment explicitly states an action but remains vague on how to execute it, it falls under the rubric level corresponding to an explicit but vague action.
